name: decimalSetMutation
source: decimal a=1.0; decimal b=1.00; Set<decimal> values=[a].ToSet(); values.Add(b); bool same=values.Count==1; values.Remove(b); return same && values.Count==0;

name: decimalListRemove
source: decimal a=1.0; decimal b=1.00; List<decimal> values=[a]; values.Remove(b); return values.Count==0;

name: decimalNullable
source: decimal a=1.0; List<decimal?> values=[null,a]; return values.Contains(null) && values.Contains(1.00) && values.IndexOf(1.00)==1;

name: floatMutation
source: List<float> values=[]; values.Add(16777217); values.Insert(0,16777217); values.Remove(16777217); return values.Count==1 && values[0]==16777216.0;

name: floatContains
source: List<float> values=[16777216.0]; int search=16777217; return values.Contains(search);

name: floatIndexOf
source: List<float> values=[16777216.0]; int search=16777217; return values.IndexOf(search)==0;

name: floatBinding
source: int value=16777217; float result=value; return result==16777216.0;

name: VectorDistinct
source: Vector2 a = new Vector2(1, 2); Vector2 b = new Vector2(1, 2); return [a, b].Distinct().Count == 1;

name: VectorContains
source: Vector2 a = new Vector2(1, 2); Vector2 b = new Vector2(1, 2); return [a].ToSet().Contains(b);

name: VectorSet
source: Vector2 a = new Vector2(1, 2); Vector2 b = new Vector2(1, 2); return [a, b].ToSet().Count == 1;

name: InfinitySet
source: float inf=Math.Log(0); Set<float> s=[inf,inf].ToSet(); return s.Count==1 && s.Contains(inf);

name: SignedZeroSet
source: float zero=0.0; Set<float> s=[zero,-zero].ToSet(); return s.Count==1 && s.Contains(-zero);

name: OrdinarySet
source: Set<float> s=[1.0,2.0,1.0].ToSet(); s.Remove(1.0); return s.Count==1 && s.Contains(2.0) && !s.Contains(1.0);

name: NaNRemove
source: float n=Math.Sqrt(-1); Set<float> s=[n].ToSet(); s.Remove(n); return s.Count==0;

name: NaNAdd
source: float n=Math.Sqrt(-1); Set<float> s=[n].ToSet(); s.Add(n); return s.Count==1 && s.Contains(n);
